What Apple Speak Selection is — and what your listing may claim

Apple ships Speak Selection under Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Speak Selection. When enabled, selecting text surfaces a Speak action or floating Speak button; only the highlighted passage is spoken — not the entire screen. Western indie listings often show one or more of these surfaces on the US product page. AppLocale covers paste-ready zh-Hans copy for whichever your screenshots and description already claim:

  • Selected-text Speak menu (朗读所选内容) — context menu with Speak beside Copy, Look Up, or Translate after the user highlights a paragraph. Gallery frames may show "Speak Selection", "Read selection aloud", or selected-passage playback badges.
  • Speak button overlay (朗读选择) — floating Speak control that appears after text selection when Speak Selection is enabled. Marketing art may highlight the overlay button beside highlighted text.
  • Selected passage playback (朗读所选文字) — in-app ebook, article, or study tools where users highlight a sentence or paragraph and hear it read back. Screenshot overlays often show selection handles with a play or Speak icon.
  • Spoken Content settings alignment (口述内容) — voice picker, speaking rate, and pronunciation controls under the Spoken Content branch when your English gallery shows Settings-style captures. Include 口述内容 vocabulary only when your US listing already frames Spoken Content settings — not as a generic hub paragraph.

Speak Selection-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Selected-text read-aloud marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Speak Selection in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 朗读所选内容 for Speak Selection under 辅助功能 → 口述内容 (Spoken Content). Related commerce phrasing includes 朗读选择 (read selection), 朗读所选文字 (read selected text), and 口述内容 when your gallery shows the Spoken Content settings branch — not as a standalone hub title. Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic medical or literacy-test claims.

Speak Selection vs Speak Screen

Speak Screen reads everything visible on screen — 朗读屏幕, 整屏朗读. Speak Selection reads only highlighted text — 朗读所选内容, 朗读选择. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply full-page swipe-to-read when your English source only shows a context-menu Speak action or Speak button overlay. See the Speak Screen listing guide only if full-screen read-aloud is your lead marketing claim.

Speak Selection vs Live Speech and Personal Voice

Live Speech speaks user-typed phrases in conversations — 实时语音, 键入朗读. Personal Voice trains an on-device voice identity — 个人声音. Speak Selection reads existing visible text the user selects — 朗读所选内容. If your English gallery shows a type-to-speak keyboard or voice-training wizard, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to Speak Selection claims unless that is what the frame shows.

Speak Selection vs Voice Control and Vocal Shortcuts

Voice Control sends spoken commands to tap and swipe UI elements — 语音控制. Vocal Shortcuts runs actions from custom spoken phrase triggers — 声音快捷指令. Speak Selection outputs audio from highlighted text — different input direction and buyer intent. Do not paste Voice Control vocabulary onto Speak Selection screenshots unless the frame shows numbered overlay commands.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need selected-text read-aloud search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 朗读所选内容, 朗读选择, and 听读 each signal different intent from 朗读屏幕 or 实时语音 keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Speak Selection" headlines on gallery frames showing selected-text menus — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

AppLocale FAQ

Is Speak Selection the same as Speak Screen?

No. Speak Selection reads only highlighted text — 朗读所选内容, 朗读选择. Speak Screen reads everything visible on screen — 朗读屏幕, 整屏朗读. See our Speak Screen listing guide only if full-page read-aloud is your lead marketing claim.

Is Speak Selection the same as Live Speech or Personal Voice?

No. Live Speech covers type-to-speak — users compose custom phrases to speak in conversations. Personal Voice covers on-device voice banking. Speak Selection covers selected-text read-aloud of visible content — different buyer stories with different screenshot vocabulary.

Is Speak Selection the same as Voice Control, Vocal Shortcuts, or Typing Feedback?

No. Voice Control sends spoken commands to operate the UI. Vocal Shortcuts runs actions from spoken phrase triggers. Typing Feedback speaks characters while typing. Speak Selection reads a user-selected passage aloud — 朗读所选内容. Different features, different Connect string families.
